82088.subject: Gnosis Pay Confirms Breach of Card Customer Data
82088.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Gnosis Pay**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/gnosis-pay-confirms-breach-of-consumer-card-system)[ confirmed a breach of card customers' data](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/gnosis-pay-confirms-breach-of-consumer-card-system)

* [**Elliptic**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-hackers-swap-50-million-in-xrp-mostly-into-bitcoin-elliptic-says)[ says Binance hackers swapped $50M of XRP](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-hackers-swap-50-million-in-xrp-mostly-into-bitcoin-elliptic-says)

* [**Aave Labs**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-labs-acquires-avon-team-to-develop-fixed-rate-lending)[ bought Avon's team to build fixed-rate loans](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-labs-acquires-avon-team-to-develop-fixed-rate-lending)

* [**Threshold**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/threshold-sets-tbtc-reconnection-target-as-week-long-pause-continues)[ set a Friday night restart for tBTC](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/threshold-sets-tbtc-reconnection-target-as-week-long-pause-continues)

* [**Blockaid**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/blockaid-warns-reth-bug-can-produce-incorrect-state-proofs)[ warned of a reth bug that skews state proofs](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/blockaid-warns-reth-bug-can-produce-incorrect-state-proofs)

Lefteris Karapetsas, founder of the portfolio tracker Rotki, posted a list this morning. It showed what Gnosis Pay had exposed about him: his name, home address, full card number with its security code, and every wallet address linked to his account.

Gnosis Pay sells a Visa debit card that spends from the user's own Safe wallet on Gnosis Chain. Hours after Karapetsas posted, the company [confirmed the breach](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/gnosis-pay-confirms-breach-of-consumer-card-system). It says it detected unauthorized access to its consumer-card system on Nov. 3, that no funds moved, and that it emailed every affected customer. Gnosis Pay has not said how many customers that is. 

On June 1, an attacker [exploited the delay module](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/gnosis-pay-hit-by-delay-module-exploit-as-gnosis-pledges-to-cover-user-losses) that guards Gnosis Pay accounts. The company's [post-mortem](https://gnosispay.com/blog/post-mortem-gnosis-pay-vulnerability-exploit) put the damage at about $1.8 million, and Gnosis covered the losses. Gnosis Pay then redeployed its account modules in tranches. By our count from Gnosis Chain logs, it set up about 71,100 card accounts on the new template that month, then 5,087 in July. On Sept. 21, Gnosis Pay told cardholders it would [retire its consumer cards on Dec. 20](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/gnosis-pay-sets-dec-20-card-shutdown-as-it-shifts-to-b2b) and sell card programs to other companies. In October, it set up 1,731 new accounts. The breach came 47 days before the shutdown.

Caption: 

# Friday charts: The Ramsey rule of data centers

When a tax collector looks at an airport, what they see is a giant ATM.

Airports generate property tax, income tax, and payroll tax, of course. But that’s just the cover charge.

At Pittsburgh International Airport, for example, there’s an extra 11.5% tax on parking (in addition to the usual sales tax). At Chicago O’Hare, “concession recovery fees” and “customer facility charges” can add as much as 50% to the cost of renting a car.

At every airport, passengers pay a 7.5% federal excise tax on the price of their ticket, a $5.30 “per-segment” fee for each takeoff and landing, a $4.50 “passenger facility charge” for each airport they depart from, and an $11.20 TSA fee per round trip. All told, a $150 flight might cost another $60 in fees and taxes.

The numbers add up fast. In 2025, Dallas Fort Worth International Airport paid an [estimated](https://www.dfwairport.com/dfwnewsroom/study-dfw-airport-now-contributes-usd78-3-billion-annually-to-north-texas/) $14 billion in federal taxes, $5 billion in state taxes, and $3.4 billion in local taxes. 

(It also has a 5% “venue tax” on rental cars that helps pay for the Dallas Mavericks’ basketball arena.) 

But the planes that flew in and out of Dallas? They might not have paid any.

Specialized leasing companies own about half the world’s fleet of commercial airplanes, and most of these companies are legally based in Ireland where corporate income tax is 15%. After deductions for depreciation, the effective tax rate on income earned on these airplanes is approximately zero.

That is a very good deal, of course, and the reason airplanes have negotiated it is that they can easily be moved.

82080.body:
View this post on the web at https://uniswap.substack.com/p/a-market-for-fees

Community news
Permissioned Pools for real estate: For the first time ever, a permissioned asset is live on the Uniswap AMM. Groma [ https://substack.com/redirect/93c08e0a-54bf-472a-94cb-b8d3db990394?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] brings real estate issuance and redemption directly to the protocol with the Permissioned Pools hook [ https://substack.com/redirect/f476638c-b326-41b1-8241-4fc2fbb2fbd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 
Uniswap v4 is now an aggregator: Last month, we shipped Aggregator Hooks. They’re v4 hooks that wrap outside liquidity sources. One swap reaches liquidity wherever it lives. More here. [ https://substack.com/redirect/1b5e31b3-3749-4111-b3ea-aaf40b05cbe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]
StablePair for stock tokens: Ondo Stocks are live on Robinhood Chain [ https://substack.com/redirect/e97376b3-2419-4d0e-82ca-2885abe5e087?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. 15 Ondo tokenized stocks and ETFs can now bridge over from Ethereum and BNB Chain. StablePair pools pair them with Robinhood Stock Tokens. Swappers get better prices, and LPs keep more of the value. [ https://substack.com/redirect/117e7ca0-89f0-4cbd-ba9a-fc1e441b791c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]
Where tokenized value trades: Uniswap is now the top venue for onchain tokenized stocks with more than $20B in trading volume to date [ https://substack.com/redirect/2eb54e34-7fa8-46c5-b602-5c0e4fc05e8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ].
Markets that never close: Last week, 62% of tokenized stock volume on Uniswap traded after market hours [ https://substack.com/redirect/bc1058d2-500d-45e7-b621-f68d4f97f439?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]. Open all night, open forever 🦄
TJAR: permissionless infrastructure for onchain fee conversion
TJAR [ https://substack.com/redirect/69dfc4f2-dff3-4776-8f03-564fb2244ba6?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is open source infrastructure built to streamline fees for teams. We break down how it works, what incentivizes searchers to run conversions, and how apps can set up TJAR for their own use cases.
Onchain systems often collect a large mix of tokens, ranging from blue chips to long tails and dust. Ultimately, they just want to convert them into a single token.
TJAR turns this conversion into an open market. Fees accumulate in a Token Jar, and searchers compete to exchange a fixed amount of the chosen token for assets in the jar.
The destination of the chosen token is configurable to support common patterns in DeFi, such as routing it to a treasury, burning it, or bridging it to an L1 recipient.
TJAR grew out of the infrastructure built for Uniswap protocol fees [ https://subst
